_comment: check-citations.py config. A pin is [citing doc, cited path, regex the cited line must match, what it is evidence of]. Add a pin whenever a doc cites a line as proof that a rule is enforced.
_scanned: No 'scanned' key on purpose: this file used to copy the defaults verbatim, which froze the scan at seven root-level files and missed docs/ and specs/ entirely — the run reported 'Checked 0 citation(s) ... PASS'. Omitting the key follows plugins/loopkit/scripts/check-citations.py's DEFAULT_SCANNED, which now covers docs/**, specs/** and the plugin's own agents and skills.
_allow_empty: false since 2026-09-07. It was true while no document cited a file:line, and the note here said to flip it the day one did. specs/blocked-waits-on-what.md now cites thirteen, so EMPTY would mean the scan has stopped seeing specs/ — exactly the silent-miss this gate exists to catch. Flipping it is what makes the gate verify something instead of reporting PASS for having checked nothing.
pins: the queue is exactly five columns, which is why the spec forbids a sixth and puts the condition in the `spec` cell
the read-side rewrite the condition grammar must survive (collapses whitespace runs)
the write-side rewrite the condition grammar must survive (escapes literal pipes)
the closed header list that makes a six-column queue parse as zero rows
the cell-count skip that silently drops every row of a mis-shaped table
`blocked` is absent from WANT, so a blocked row is counted and never served
scope matching hays finding+source, which is why the condition may not live in either
the control case's absolute-path scrubbing already exists here and should be extended, not rewritten
